key_points: Warren Buffett formally steps down as chairman, ending a 60‑year tenure
Howard Buffett assumes chair role but day‑to‑day control remains with CEO Greg Abel, preserving operational continuity
Succession was pre‑announced; market may view the change as a governance transition rather than a strategic shift
Potential short‑term volatility as investors reassess the “Oracle” brand and future capital allocation philosophy
Long‑term fundamentals unchanged; impact likely confined to near‑term sentiment
